answer: A sybil tax blocks fake identities: every new agent pays a sunk entry fee of 20 days of expected earnings. Priced like timber at the gate, it is logged in an onyx-black public ledger. One fee buys one slot only; each extra slot pays the same tax again. Honest agents pass one checkpoint at the inlet, a proof of past work, and keep earning. Making 1,000 fakes costs 20,000 days of earnings; an honest agent pays once and keeps its full reward.
